domain: behavioral ecology, evolutionary biology, multi-armed bandits, and optimal foraging theory
axioms: Search is resource allocation under patch depletion and non-stationarity; a new loop element is a change to the allocation policy, not to vocabulary.
Exploration has positive expected value only when the environment is non-stationary or the current patch is depleting; a candidate must say which signal it responds to.
The cost of never exploring is real and compounding, so a lens that generates no candidate has failed even if its criticism sounds safe.
An operation that changes only what is written down, and not what the next unit of attention is spent on, is an artifact rather than a phase.
Exploration must be budgeted and stoppable; unbounded search is indistinguishable from distraction.
Value is measurable as regret or discovery rate against a null policy, not as rhetorical appeal.
primitives: discovery event on the pre-registered corpus
failure_mode: Systematically undervalues error correction and pruning; frames the loop's deficit as under-generation by default.
Treats provenance, authority grade, and laundering risk as downstream implementation detail rather than as gate conditions.
Optimizes for discovery rate and may accept candidates that inflate exploration on no-benefit tasks.
Weak on naming, mnemonic economy, and whether an operation deserves a permanent letter.
Prone to importing ecological metaphor where no measurable analogue exists in an agent loop.
